blocks.text: Buying a Home in Vedder Crossing, Chilliwack: Local Market & Neighbourhood Guide

parts.t: Vedder Crossing

is a key residential search area in the eastern Fraser Valley connected via Vedder Road south to the Vedder Bridge, Promontory Road, Peach Road, and Keith Wilson Road. Buyers comparing active MLS® listings in Vedder Crossing will find strata townhomes, riverside condos, compact single-family detached homes, and contemporary infill developments within walking distance of the Vedder Bridge and Garrison Village. blocks.text: Schools, Parks & Commuting in Vedder Crossing

parts.t: Families looking at homes for sale in Vedder Crossing are served by Vedder Elementary (45850 Promontory Road), Vedder Middle School, G.W. Graham Secondary, and the UFV Chilliwack Campus at Canada Education Park. Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include Vedder Park (off Peach Road with playground, off-leash dog park, and riverfront greenspace) and the Vedder River Rotary Trail for walking, cycling, and salmon fishing. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by BC Transit Route 51 (Vedder Road to UFV and Downtown Chilliwack), Route 54 (Promontory), and summer Route 56 (Cultus Lake).

blocks.text: Zoning, Land Use Plans & Buyer Due Diligence in Vedder Crossing

parts.t: Land use and building permits in Vedder Crossing are regulated by the South Vedder Neighbourhood Plan (OCP Schedule E), Chilliwack 2050 OCP mixed-use and medium-density guidelines along Vedder Road, and Vedder River floodplain bylaws. Before removing subjects on a property in Vedder Crossing, verify the title search (checking for statutory building schemes, easements, geotechnical or floodplain covenants, and freehold vs. leasehold tenure) and estimate your closing taxes with our

Residents of Vedder Crossing have access to Vedder Park (off Peach Road with playground, off-leash dog park, and riverfront greenspace) and the Vedder River Rotary Trail for walking, cycling, and salmon fishing. See our

How are roads, highway access, and public transit in Vedder Crossing?

Key road corridors serving Vedder Crossing include Vedder Road south to the Vedder Bridge, Promontory Road, Peach Road, and Keith Wilson Road. Public transit connections include BC Transit Route 51 (Vedder Road to UFV and Downtown Chilliwack), Route 54 (Promontory), and summer Route 56 (Cultus Lake).
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in Vedder Crossing?

Properties in Vedder Crossing are governed by the South Vedder Neighbourhood Plan (OCP Schedule E), Chilliwack 2050 OCP mixed-use and medium-density guidelines along Vedder Road, and Vedder River floodplain bylaws. Before writing an offer, check the parcel's exact zoning, Development Permit Area overlays, and floodplain elevation requirements.
Are homes in Vedder Crossing freehold or leasehold?

Most residential properties in Vedder Crossing are freehold (fee simple) or freehold strata, though select developments in the broader Chilliwack and Cultus Lake region sit on prepaid leasehold land. Always check the Title Type field on each MLS® listing and review the title search with your Realtor and lawyer.
